title: Uniform distribution under matrix indexing
statement: Let $\\mathcal F$ be a finite family of subsets of $\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$, and let $m$ be a natural number. Choose uniformly a function from $\\{1,\\ldots,|\\mathcal F|m\\}$ to the Boolean cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, then reindex its values as a function on $\\mathcal F\\times\\{1,\\ldots,m\\}$. The resulting distribution is uniform on the functions from $\\mathcal F$ to the set of functions from $\\{1,\\ldots,m\\}$ to $\\{-1,1\\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $\\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of $\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$
